Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
1. does ventrue investment count as an investment? by cardtext it should be
no. but on the other hand it would make sense to add that little word
"investment".

2. kyoko shinsegawa hunts. what happens if she has aaron's feeding razor /
the inbase discotek is tapped / her controller controlls the hungry coyote
and she is sabbat?

from card text i would say she steals an additional blood / she gains the
second blood from the blood bank / she steals an additional blood.

3. does tyler untap and gain a blood when she plays amaranth?

thanks,

pallando

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> 1. does ventrue investment count as an investment? by cardtext it should be
> no. but on the other hand it would make sense to add that little word
> "investment".

No errata has been issued.

> 2. kyoko shinsegawa hunts. what happens if she has aaron's feeding razor /
> the inbase discotek is tapped / her controller controlls the hungry coyote
> and she is sabbat?

She steals one blood from the target vampire.

> from card text i would say she steals an additional blood / she gains the
> second blood from the blood bank / she steals an additional blood.

It follows the Legacy of Cain precedent:
The amount gained (stolen) by the Legacy of Cain hunt action is not affected
by effects that affect the amount gained by hunting (e.g., Aaron's Feeding
Razor). [RTR 19970630]

> 3. does tyler untap and gain a blood when she plays amaranth?

Yes. Card text.

Does this really apply to Inbase Discotek? By card text, you simply tap it

Messages.Author: Thomas Pichler
Messages.Body:


Just like Aaron's Feeding Razor or the Hungry Coyote.

Here's how I'd interpret the ruling:
Basically, both LoC and Kyoko have slightly confusing wording - the
essential part being that the vampire does X "instead of the usual
hunt(ing) action" and is therefore not performing an actual hunt(ing)
action.
AFR, THC and ID apply only to actual hunt(ing) actions.

Is this correct?

Thomas
